notes.title: Cardpocalypse with devs Colm Larkin & Fred Mangan
notes.content:
Game Director Colm Larkin and Creative Director Fred Mangan will play Cardpocalypse while providing background commentary and insights into its creation.


First hour: Gauntlet Mode - Colm & Fred playing the roguelike challenge mode, joined by Game Designer Angelo Nikolaou

Second hour: Out Of Time - Colm & Fred playing the standalone narrative expansion, joined by Game Writer Ellen Cunningham
